paper_title: Narrative Media Framing in Political Discourse
caption: Distribution of articles across political leanings of the outlets
model_annotation: This pie chart represents the distribution of articles across different political leanings of outlets, showing four categories. The chart is divided into four slices, each labeled and colored distinctly. The "Right bias" slice, colored blue, occupies 30.0%. The "Left bias" slice, colored orange, occupies 28.0%. The "Questionable source" slice, colored green, occupies 22.0%. The "Left center bias" slice, colored red, occupies 20.0%. Each slice displays its percentage and a numerical value in parentheses. The slices are arranged in a clockwise order from largest to smallest by percentage, but this ordering is not strictly descending. There is no legend provided, and no slices are visually emphasized beyond their color and label distinctions.
